aiSettings.title: AI: categories and reports
aiSettings.help: Suggests categories for movements that rules and memory left uncategorised and, at the start of each month, writes a report on the previous month in Insights › Reports. It always applies a category; with lower confidence the movement stays in To review for you to confirm, and after three failed attempts it goes to Other and is flagged for review.

aiSettings.neverBody: account names, IBANs, balances of individual accounts, notes, household member names.
aiSettings.caveat: For categories, a description can include a merchant's or a person's name as it appears on the statement. Reports never include descriptions.

aiSettings.reportsSentBody: totals for the month, the month before and the average of the three months before; the names and amounts of category groups and budget lines; recurring payments, by name only when you confirmed or renamed them and otherwise by category; net worth; and the month's anomalies, which include the day, category and amount of large movements. Never the movement descriptions.
